subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should maintainers accept this PR's custom extra-bootstrap glob resolver as the upgrade-safe replacement for fs.glob once exact-head checks are green?
rationale: The code appears correct and well-scoped, but replacing fs.glob on a shipped config surface can alter bootstrap context for existing users in edge cases, which is a maintainer merge-risk choice rather than an automated repair.

options.title: Require exact-head validation first
options.body: Wait for queued CI/OpenGrep and any required QA lane to pass or be shown unrelated before merging this fs.glob replacement.

options.title: Accept focused proof scope
options.body: Maintainers may accept the direct loadExtraBootstrapFiles terminal proof and focused parity tests without a full connected-channel embedded_run proof.

options.title: Split the riskier surfaces
options.body: If glob parity remains uncomfortable, split async root reads, yielding glob resolution, and hook scheduling into narrower PRs.

recommendation.title: Require exact-head validation first
recommendation.body: Wait for queued CI/OpenGrep and any required QA lane to pass or be shown unrelated before merging this fs.glob replacement.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has high-confidence history on boundary-safe bootstrap reads and hook contract preservation, the two most compatibility-sensitive parts of this PR.
